Reminder: Cocktails tomorrow at Hotel Gran Melia Don Pepe We're looking forward to seeing you! Get ready to unwind with us tomorrow night during The Essence-Marbella with cocktails and a mojito bar.
The event details are as follows:
- Where: Hotel Gran Melia Don Pepe (right across the street from the convention center!) - When: Wednesday, March 29th | 5:45 PM - 7:45 PM - What: Drinks, food, and fun with your friends from Flywire!
In the meantime, stop by the Flywire booth to talk to the team about your payment challenges.
